launchers.author: danennh11
launchers.summary: Terminal-pane launcher with a λ prompt
launchers.description: Super+Space opens a small terminal pane: a dark-blue pill names it, you type after a λ with an fzf-style match count at the end of the line, and results are rows you walk with the arrows or vim keys (Ctrl+J/K), open with Enter or Alt+1..9. Pinned apps come first, apps opened this session rise next, and every colour comes from the live palette.
